# Reviewer (cms-admin)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: [`reviewer`](../../flows/reviewer/FLOW.md).

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

The owner's side of reviewer access (D2, D2a): read and change the reviewer switch, page through the reviewer session log. It also holds the banner a reviewer session sees in the admin console.

## Techniques

A feature module: an API factory registered through `Features.registry.ts` (`apiServices`), provided to pages by a React context; TanStack Query hooks for server data. `404 REVIEWER_FEATURE_OFF` (the deploy switch is off) is detected and shown as "off", not as an error; a 4xx answer is final, only network and 5xx retry. The permission subject `reviewer_settings` gates the nav link.

## Technologies

Axios, TanStack Query, React.

## Entry points

`createReviewerApi`, `useReviewerEnabledQuery`, `useReviewerSessionsQuery`, `isReviewerFeatureOff`, `ReviewerBanner` (rendered by the app shell), `REVIEWER_SETTINGS_SUBJECT`.

## Where to change what

Page size of the log: `Reviewer.constants.ts` (API default 20, max 100). New reviewer calls: `Reviewer.api.ts` and `Reviewer.queries.ts`.
